facts.fact: Mozambique has three electronic money institutions, M-Pesa, e-Mola and M-Kesh, providing mobile money transfers and payments, with 24,626,613 e-money accounts at end-November 2025 per Bank of Mozambique data.
The Instant Payment System, in force 2026-03-02, brings together banks and digital wallets, with participation mandatory for electronic money institutions and mobile wallets, per Lusa.
The Bank of Mozambique's Instant Payment System, operated by SIMO and running 24 hours a day, connects banks and mobile wallets nationally from 2026-03-02.

systems.owner: Bank of Mozambique, operated by SIMO
systems.tiers: individuals 200,000 MZN and legal entities 500,000 MZN daily limits
